title.raw: Auditions announced for live radio play of 'A Christmas Carol'
title.rendered: Auditions announced for live radio play of ‘A Christmas Carol’

excerpt.raw: The TCT Off-Broadway is holding auditions for a live radio adaptation of 'A Christmas Carol,' seeking five featured actors and additional roles.
excerpt.rendered: The TCT Off-Broadway is holding auditions for a live radio adaptation of ‘A Christmas Carol,’ seeking five featured actors and additional roles.

content.raw:
Theatre Carolina Theatre is holding auditions for a live radio play adaptation of Charles Dickens' classic, "A Christmas Carol." The production aims to bring the holiday story to life through sound effects, multiple characters, and festive spirit.

Auditions are scheduled for Oct. 11 at 2 p.m. and Oct. 12 at 6 p.m. They will be held at TCT Off-Broadway, located at 213 East Franklin Street. Participants should arrive prepared with audition material, which will be provided. No previous radio experience is required, only a love for storytelling and a willingness to have fun.

The production is seeking five featured actors—three men and two women, ages 20 and up. Additional roles may be available. Performances are set for Dec. 10 to 12. The play will include sound effects and holiday themes, aiming to capture the magic of Christmas.

Tickets and further details are available through Theatre Carolina Theatre. The production invites actors of all experience levels to join and help bring this timeless story to life during the holiday season.

Source: Original Article
